description: NeverApply is an AI-curated global job board that structures and filters job listings and helps users search, track, and apply to roles. It also offers AI-assisted resume tailoring, interview preparation, and agent-facing access to job and profile data.
summary: NeverApply exposes two developer integration surfaces on neverapply.co: an authenticated REST Jobs API described by an OpenAPI document, and an OAuth-protected remote MCP server over Streamable HTTP.
